questions.question: What does Amos 5 urge the people to do that they may live?
options: Gather riches and store them up
Seek the LORD and seek good, not evil
Offer up very many sacrifices at Bethel
questions.answer: Seek the LORD and seek good, not evil

questions.question: What famous call for justice appears in Amos 5?
options: Let your many offerings cover over the whole altar, day after day after day
Let your sacrifices rise up like sweet incense, both in the morning and evening
Let your songs fill the whole of the temple, both loud and entirely unceasing
Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream
questions.answer: Let justice roll down like waters, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream
